proposals.reason: Chinese 鄆州 is Yunzhou; Yanzhou is 兗州. The idiomatic line wrongly uses Yanzhou for 鄆州.

proposals.before: On guiyou he reached Yan prefecture.
proposals.after: On guiyou he reached Yun prefecture.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄆州 is Yun prefecture; rendering it as Yan prefecture confuses it with 兗州.

proposals.before: On jimao, as dawn was late in coming, the vanguard reached Bian city; Siyuan had his men seize prisoners and assault the Fengqiu gate, and Liang Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan asked to surrender the city.
proposals.after: On jimao near dawn, the vanguard reached Bian city; Siyuan had his men seize prisoners and assault the Fengqiu gate, and Liang Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan asked to surrender the city.
proposals.reason: 遲明 means near dawn / at daybreak, not that dawn was late in coming.

proposals.before: He demoted Zheng Jue to Lai registrar, Xiao Qing to Deng registrar, Liu Yue to Jun vice-marshal, Ren Zan to Fang vice-marshal, Yao Yi to Fu vice-marshal, Feng Qiao to Tang vice-marshal, Li Yi to Huai vice-marshal, Dou Mengzheng to Yi vice-marshal, Liu Guangsu to Mi registrar, Lu Chong to An registrar, and Wang Quan to Sui registrar, all supernumerary with acting full rank.
proposals.after: He demoted Zheng Jue to Lai prefecture registrar, Xiao Qing to Deng prefecture registrar, Liu Yue to Jun prefecture vice-marshal, Ren Zan to Fang prefecture vice-marshal, Yao Yi to Fu prefecture vice-marshal, Feng Qiao to Tang prefecture vice-marshal, Li Yi to Huai prefecture vice-marshal, Dou Mengzheng to Yi prefecture vice-marshal, Liu Guangsu to Mi prefecture registrar, Lu Chong to An prefecture registrar, and Wang Quan to Sui prefecture registrar, all supernumerary with acting full rank.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic line drops the prefecture noun present in Chinese (萊州/登州/安州 etc.), obscuring that these are prefectural posts.

proposals.before: On yiwei Dou Lu Ge was told to run the upper Personnel board and Li Detiu the eastern and western boards.
proposals.after: On yiwei Dou Luge was told to run the upper Personnel board and Li Dehui the eastern and western boards.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李德休 is Li Dehui (Déxiū); Detiu is a corrupted spelling. Dou Lu Ge should match the established Dou Luge spacing.

proposals.before: On bingshen Duan Ning of Huazhou kept his acting post and took the imperial surname with the name Shaocheng.
proposals.after: On bingshen Duan Ning of Huazhou kept his acting post and took the imperial surname with the name Shaoqin.
proposals.reason: Chinese 紹欽 is Shaoqin (Shàoqīn), not Shaocheng.

proposals.before: That day Zhao Yan, Zhang Xiyi, the Zhang Hanjie brothers, Zhu Gui, Jing Xiang, Li Zhen, and the Khitan Sala Aba and their families were beheaded below Bian bridge.
proposals.after: That day Zhao Yan, Zhang Xiyi, Zhang Hanjie, Zhang Hanlun, Zhang Hanrong, Zhu Gui, Jing Xiang, Li Zhen, and the Khitan Sala Aba and their families were beheaded below Bian bridge.
proposals.reason: Chinese names 張漢傑、張漢倫、張漢融 as three individuals; collapsing them to 'the Zhang Hanjie brothers' hides two personal names.

proposals.before: Qiu had once been a horse officer; in Tianyou 13, when Cunxu faced Liu Yan at Shen, he took seven hundred horse to Liang—now he came to plead guilt.
proposals.after: Qiu had once been a horse officer; in Tianyou 13, when Cunxu faced Liu Xun at Shen, he took seven hundred horse to Liang—now he came to plead guilt.
proposals.reason: Chinese 劉鄩 is Liu Xun; Yan is a misleading English rendering of 鄩.

proposals.before: Li Shaocheng, acting Huazhou commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.
proposals.after: Li Shaoqin, acting Huazhou commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李紹欽 is Li Shaoqin; Shaocheng mismatches 欽.

proposals.before: Li Jiyao of Anyi came to court to await judgment and was pardoned.
proposals.after: Li Jitao of Anyi came to court to await judgment and was pardoned.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李繼韜 is Li Jitao (Jìtāo); Jiyao mismatches 韜.

proposals.before: Kong Qing of Xiang—acting Grand Tutor and chancellor—kept Xiangzhou unchanged.
proposals.after: Kong of Xiang—acting Grand Tutor and chancellor—kept Xiangzhou unchanged.
proposals.reason: Chinese text gives only the surname 孔 and omits the given name; inventing Qing is unsupported by the chapter wording.

proposals.before: Song became Guide, Bian Kaifeng Xuanwu again, Hua Ganhua to Zhenguo, Xu Kuangguo to Zhongwu, Hua Xuanyi to Yicheng, Shaan Zhenguo to Baoyi, Yao Jingsheng to Shunyi, Lu Kuangyi to Anyi, Lang Wushun to Wuzhen, Yan to Zhangwu, Deng to Weisheng, Jin to Jianxiong, and An to Anyuan.
proposals.after: Songzhou's Xuanwu became Guide; Bianzhou's Kaifeng Prefecture became Xuanwu again; Huazhou's Ganhua became Zhenguo; Xuzhou's Kuangguo became Zhongwu; Huazhou's Xuanyi became Yicheng; Shanzhou's Zhenguo became Baoyi; Yaozhou's Jingsheng became Shunyi; Luzhou's Kuangyi became Anyi; Langzhou's Wushun became Wuzhen; Yanzhou became Zhangwu; Dengzhou became Weisheng; Jinzhou became Jianxiong; and Anzhou became Anyuan.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic line collapses Chinese place-command pairs and confuses 滑州感化軍 with a second Hua; 滑州 is Huazhou (Hua) while 華州 is also Hua in the English, which obscures two different prefectures.

proposals.before: On xinsi Li Jiyao of Anyi was demoted to Deng long-history, then beheaded at the Tianjin Bridge for plotting revolt again.
proposals.after: On xinsi Li Jitao of Anyi was demoted to Dengzhou long-history, then beheaded at the Tianjin Bridge for plotting revolt again.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李繼韜 is Li Jitao; Jiyao mismatches 韜. 登州 is Dengzhou.

proposals.before: On jisi Palace Attendant Cui Juyi was made Vice Minister of Punishments and charged as reviser of the History Office with direction of its affairs.
proposals.after: On jisi Palace Attendant Cui Jujian was made Vice Minister of Punishments and charged as reviser of the History Office with direction of its affairs.
proposals.reason: Chinese 崔居儉 is Cui Jujian; Juyi is a corrupted spelling.

decisions.reason: 鄆州 is Yunzhou; the existing Yanzhou incorrectly represents a different prefecture name.
The literal translation likewise confuses 鄆州 with Yan Prefecture and should read Yun Prefecture.
遲明 denotes the time around daybreak, not an anomalous delay in dawn's arrival.
Each office is attached to a named zhou; retaining 'prefecture' makes the list intelligible in English.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 鄭玨為萊州司戶，蕭頃為登州司戶，翰林學士劉嶽為均州司馬。

decisions.after: On yiwei Dou Luge was told to run the upper Personnel board and Li Dexiu the eastern and western boards.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly repairs both names but mistypes 德休 as Dehui; standard pinyin is Dexiu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 詔宰相豆盧革權判吏部上銓，御史中丞李德休權判東西銓事。

decisions.reason: The bestowed name is 紹欽, Shaoqin; Shaocheng has no support in the Chinese text.
The source explicitly lists Zhang Hanjie, Zhang Hanlun, and Zhang Hanrong as three named people.
The named opponent is Liu Xun, 劉鄩; 'Liu Yan' is a mistranscription of the given name.
李紹欽 is Li Shaoqin; the existing Shaocheng is inconsistent with the attested bestowed name.
The commissioner's name is 李繼韜, Li Jitao; Jiyao incorrectly represents the final character.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 安義軍節度使李繼韜入見待罪

decisions.reason: Although this annal abbreviates the name to 孔, the parallel career and biography identify the Xiangzhou commissioner as Kong Qing, 孔勍.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孔勍，字鼎文，兗州人，後徙家宿州。

decisions.after: The Xuanwu Army at Songzhou was renamed the Guide Army; Kaifeng Prefecture at Bianzhou again became the Xuanwu Army; the Ganhua Army at Huazhou became the Zhenguo Army; the Kuangguo Army at Xuzhou again became the Zhongwu Army; the Xuanyi Army at Huazhou again became the Yicheng Army; the Zhenguo Army at Shanzhou again became the Baoyi Army; the Jingsheng Army at Yaozhou again became the Shunyi Army; the Kuangyi Army at Luzhou again became the Anyi Army; the Wushun Army at Langzhou again became the Wuzhen Army; Yanzhou became the Zhangwu Army, Dengzhou the Weisheng Army, Jinzhou the Jianxiong Army, and Anzhou the Anyuan Army.
decisions.reason: The proposed expansion is right, but explicitly naming each military command as an Army preserves 軍 and makes the renamings clear.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 改宋州宣武軍為歸德軍，汴州開封府復為宣武軍，滑州感化軍為鎮國軍。

decisions.reason: 李繼韜 is Li Jitao and 登州 is Dengzhou; both corrections directly follow the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 貶安義軍節度使李繼韜為登州長史

decisions.reason: The official is 崔居儉, Cui Jujian; the existing Juyi omits the final character and misreads the name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以中書舍人崔居儉為刑部侍郎
